trivia.description: Answer a question and earn XP

jarvis.xp: Add or remove XP from a member
jarvis.recalcular: Rebuild a member's progress from the ledger
jarvis.nova: Creates a trivia question (opens a form)
jarvis.autor: Only questions created by this staff member

jarvis.desativar: Takes a question out of play at once
jarvis.exportar: Downloads the staff questions as YAML
jarvis.importar: Imports a mission from a .yaml file
jarvis.missao_lista: Lists missions and where they came from
jarvis.missao_desativar: Takes a mission out of play
jarvis.trivia_arquivo: The .yaml file with the questions (same format as export)
jarvis.campanha_importar: Imports a campaign and its missions from a .yaml
jarvis.campanha_arquivo: A .yaml file with campaign and missions
jarvis.item_dar: Gives an item to a member
jarvis.creditos_dar: Gives (or removes, with a negative number) credits
jarvis.item_arquivo: The .yaml file with the items (from the website editor or the export)
jarvis.item_exportar: Download the staff items as YAML
jarvis.item_desativar: Take an item out of play (unequips it from everyone)
